description: A human-labeled set for calibrating the breach judge. Each item pairs an adversarial probe with an illustrative target response and a ground-truth label (breached or not). Responses are benign, synthetic illustrations of compliance/refusal for testing the JUDGE — not harmful content. Stratified across strategy families and balanced breach/safe. Run `polygraph calibrate` to score the judge against these labels.
